scripts.generate:client: pnpm run generate:client:v2 && pnpm run generate:client:v3
scripts.generate:client:v2: dotnet kiota generate -l CSharp -c SaksarkivClient -n Arbeidstilsynet.Common.Saksarkiv -d AT.Common.Saksarkiv.Publish/openApi.json -o AT.Common.Saksarkiv.Publish/Generated --exclude-backward-compatible --clean-output
scripts.generate:client:v3: dotnet kiota generate -l CSharp -c SaksarkivClientV3 -n Arbeidstilsynet.Common.Saksarkiv.V3 -d AT.Common.Saksarkiv.Publish/openApiV3.json -o AT.Common.Saksarkiv.Publish/Generated/V3 --exclude-backward-compatible --clean-output
